svg.title: Nobs Panel wiring diagram
svg.text: 8 toggles (SW1–SW6 ON-ON, SW7–SW8 ON-OFF-ON) · status LED · standard right mount
CONTROLS BESIDE THEIR PINS · USB UP · ANALOG HEADER ON THE LEFT
• Pins and placement follow arduino-esp-32-wiring.md and wiring-diagram.pdf (standard right mount). Left mount uses
• Switch pin 2 (center) goes to GND; pins 1 and 3 go to the signal pins.
